origin: ts.mbt — the hazard the fuzzer's sink shape cannot reach (its only sink is `console.log`, whose semantics are known)
what: `class_method_dce`'s `keep` was the export surface and nothing else, so it had no notion of a class VALUE crossing the bundle boundary: `class C { m() {} } console.log(new C())` deleted `m` under plain `mtsc --bundle`. A library bundle was protected; an application bundle was not at all. The real-world form is the protocol methods a library defines and never calls itself — `JSON.stringify` calls `toJSON`, `String(x)` calls `toString`, `await` calls `then`. The pass now takes `class_members_reachable_off_bundle`: the members of any class reaching `External` observability, plus the fixed protocol list. Feeding it the property mangler's reserved set instead was tried and reverted — that set answers 'may this NAME be renamed' and marks a class observed when an instance merely appears in an escaping subtree, which turned the pass off in all but name. Every kept name here is paired with a dropped one on the same class or through the same sink, so the fix cannot be 'switch the pass off'.
